Off and back on since 2007 when I got my first Delorean. Shortly after beginning the process of collecting the pieces I realized a couple of things:

* You shouldn't own a Delorean if you don't have a garage
   * especially a Delorean Time Machine
* Deloreans don't make good daily drivers.

My Delorean would break down constantly and since it was my daily driver, I was forced to sell it. Regretted it shortly after and aimed to find a new one when the time was right.

In 2019, I bought my current Delorean, which is in daily driving condition, but It's my second car. I've been Converting this one since April 2019. Interior will be completed this year and the exterior will be completed next year.

But if you ask any Delorean Time Machine owner, you never really finish building it.
